धर धर, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. rt. धृ),
holding, bearing, carrying; wearing; possessing, hav-
ing, possessed of, containing, keeping, sustaining,
preserving, observing, (often compounded with its
object; cf. अंशु-ध्˚, अक्ष-ध्˚, अश्रुति-ध्˚, असृग्-
ध्˚, कक्ष-ध्˚, &c.); (अस्), m. a mountain [cf.
क्षिति-ध्˚, भू-ध्˚, मही-ध्˚]; a flock of cotton;
a frivolous or dissolute man (= विट), N. of one of
the Vasus; of a hero on the side of the Pāṇḍavas;
of the king of the tortoises; of the father of Padma-
prabha, the sixth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī;
(आ), f. ‘the bearer, supporter,’ the earth, the ground;
the uterus or womb; a vein or tubular vessel of the
body; marrow; a mass of gold or heap of valuables
(representing the earth and given to Brāhmans); N.
of one of the wives of Kaśyapa, mother of the land and
water-birds, (probably = the Earth.)
—धर-पट्ट
or धर-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a prince of the Ballabhī
or Vallabhī dynasty.
—धर-संस्थ, अस्, आ, अम्,
equal to a mountain, huge as a mountain, &c.
—ध-
रा-कदम्ब, अस्, m. the Kadamba tree, Nauclea
Cadamba; [cf. धारा-कदम्ब.]
—धरात्मज
(˚रा-आत्˚), अस्, m. ‘son of the earth,’ the planet Mars
or its regent.
—धरा-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘bearing
or sustaining the earth, prop of the earth,’ an epi-
thet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; (अस्), m. a mountain.
—धराधारा (˚रा-आध्˚?), f. the earth.
—ध-
राधिप (˚रा-अध्˚), अस्, m. ‘sovereign of the earth,’
a king.
—धरान्तर-चर, अस्, आ, अम्, walking
in the interior of the earth; (probably a wrong read-
ing for धारान्तर-चर, q. v.)
—धरा-पति, इस्,
m. ‘lord of the earth,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu.
—ध-
रा-पुत्र, अस्, m. ‘son of the earth,’ the planet
Mars.
—धरा-भुज्, क्, m. ‘enjoying or possessing
the earth,’ a king.
—धरा-भृत्, त्, m. ‘sustaining
the earth,’ a mountain.
—धरामर (˚रा-अम्˚),
अस्, m. ‘a god or immortal on the earth,’ a Brāhman.
—धरा-शय, अस्, ई, अम्, sleeping on the earth,
lying on the ground.
—धरा-सूनु, उस्, m. ‘son of
the earth,’ the planet Mars.
—धरोद्धार (˚रा-
उद्˚), अस्, m. deliverance of the world.
—धरो-
पस्थ (˚रा-उप्˚), अस्, m. surface of the earth.

धार धार, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धृ, but in
some of its senses apparently connected with rt. 1.
धाव्), holding, bearing, supporting, containing, (at
the end of a comp., see असृग्-ध्˚, कर्ण-ध्˚,
जल-ध्˚, तुला-ध्˚); continuing, streaming down in
a continuous line, raining hard, flowing, dripping, (in
[]
these senses said to be connected with rt. 1. धाव्);
(अस्), m. ‘a supporter, holder,’ epithet of Viṣṇu;
a sudden and violent shower of rain; snow, hail;
frost (?); a deep place, depth; debt; a boundary,
limit, line; a sort of stone; (आ), f. the flowing or
dropping of any fluid, (said to be connected with rt.
1. धाव्); a stream or current of water, a line of
descending fluid; a water-course, a torrent, a flood, a
hard shower falling in large drops or in hail, a shower,
the dripping of any liquid, a drop, (often at the end
of a comp., cf. असृग्-ध्˚); a leak, a hole in a
pitcher &c. letting out the water; the pace of a
horse (of which five are enumerated, cf. धोरित,
वल्गित, प्लुत, उत्-तेजित, उत्-तेरित); the margin
or border of anything, the sharp edge of a sword or
any cutting instrument, the edge of anything, (often
at the end of a comp.; cf. अर्ध-ध्˚, असि-ध्˚,
क्षुर-ध्˚, खण्ड-ध्˚, खर-ध्˚); the edge of
a mountain or precipice; the circumference or peri-
phery of a wheel; a garden-wall, fence, hedge; any
continuous line or series, the line of a family; the
van or front line of an army [cf. धाराङ्कुर];
the tip of the ear, ear-lap; the highest point, excel-
lence, pre-eminence; a multitude; fame; night; tur-
meric; likeness; custom, usage (?); N. of a town;
of a sacred bathing-place; (अम्), n. rain-water (?).
—धार-पूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. purified with streams
of water; clear as water (?).
—धार-वाक, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. (Sāy.) sustaining or reciting praises.
—धारा-कदम्ब or धारा-कदम्बक, अस्, m.
a kind of Kadamba tree; N. of a poet.
—धारा-
गृह, अम्, n. a bath-room with flowing water, shower-
bath.
—धाराग्र (˚रा-अग्˚), अम्, n. the broad-
edged head of an arrow.
—धाराङ्कुर (˚रा-अङ्˚),
अस्, m. a drop of rain; hail; advancing before the
line of an army to defy the enemy.
—धाराङ्ग (˚रा-
अङ्˚), अस्, m. a sacred bathing-place; a sword, scimitar.
—धाराट (˚रा-अट), अस्, m. the Cātaka bird; a
horse; a cloud; a furious elephant or one in rut
(when juice exudes from his temples).
—धारा-
धर, अस्, m. ‘containing showers,’ a cloud; ‘hav-
ing an edge,’ a sword.
—धाराधिरूढ (˚रा-
अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, elevated to the highest point,
raised to the highest pitch.
—धारा-ध्वनि, इस्, m.
the sound of falling rain or flowing water.
—धारा-
निपात or धारा-पात, अस्, m. a fall of rain, pelting
shower; a stream of water.
—धारान्तर-चर (˚रा-
अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, moving among the showers; flying
amid the clouds (as the Cātaka bird).
—धारा-फल,
अस्, m., N. of a tree with prickly fruits (= मदन).
—धारा-यन्त्र, अम्, n. ‘machine for sprinkling
water,’ a fountain; a watering-can, a sprinkling vase
or ewer, a sort of censer.
—धारा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
having an edge, edged; (अती), f., N. of a town.
—धारा-वनि, इस्, m. wind, air.
—धारा-वर,
आस्, m. pl. ‘fond of showers,’ epithet of the Maruts;
(Sāy.) covering (the sky) with showers or preventing
the stability of stationary objects, i. e. moving them.
—धारा-वर्ष, अस्, अम्, m. n. a stream or torrent
of rain, a hard shower.
—धारा-विष, अस्, m.
‘having a poisoned edge,’ a crooked sword, a scimitar,
sabre.
—धाराश्रु (˚रा-अश्˚), उ, n. a flood of tears.
—धारा-सम्पात, अस्, m. a hard shower, a heavy
fall of rain.
—धारासार (˚रा-आस्˚), अस्, m. a heavy
downfall of rain, a hard shower.
—धारा-स्नुही, f.,
N. of a plant (= त्रिधार-स्नुही).
—धारोष्ण
(˚रा-उष्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, warm from the cow (as milk).
धारा, f. See under धार, col. 1.

धरण, अस्, ई, अम्, bearing, holding; preserving;
(अस्), m. a dike, a bank, a ridge of land answering
the purpose of a bridge &c., the side of a mountain;
the world; the sun; the female breast; rice, corn;
the Himālaya considered as king of mountains; N.
of a king of the Nāgas; (ई or धरणि, इस्), f. the
earth, the soil, the ground, the Earth personified as
the wife of Dhruva; a tubular vessel of the body, a
vein; a kind of bulbous plant, an esculent root, =
धारणीया, धीर-पत्त्री, कन्दालु, कन्दाढ्य,
[]
दण्ड-कन्दक, वन-कन्द, सु-कन्दक; the
silk-cotton tree, = शाल्मलि; a beam or rafter for a
roof; N. of a dictionary (generally called धरणि
or धरणि-कोश); (अम्), n. the act of holding,
seizing, possessing, keeping, bearing, supporting, sup-
port; bringing, procuring; a support, fastening,
prop, stay; security; a sort of weight variously
reckoned as = 10 Palas, = 16 silver Māṣakas, =
1 silver Purāṇa, = (1/10) Śatamāna, = 19 Niṣpāvas, =
(2/5) Karṣa, = (1/10) Pala, = 24 Raktikās; a particular
high number.
—धरण-प्रिया, f., N. of the
goddess executing the commands of the nineteenth
Arhat.
—धरणि-गोणिग, अस्, m., N. of a man.
—धरणि-ज, अस्, m. ‘the son of the earth,’ an
epithet of Aṅgiras or the planet Mars.
—धरणि-
धर, अस्, m. ‘the bearer of the earth,’ an epithet
of Viṣṇu; [cf. धरणी-धर.]
—धरणि-
मण्ड, N. of a place.
—धरणि-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्,
being or staying on earth.
—धरणी-कन्द, अस्,
m. an esculent root or bulb (= धरणी).
—ध-
रणी-कीलक, अस्, m. a mountain.
—धरणी-तल,
अम्, n. the surface of the earth.
—धरणी-तलश्री,
ईस्, m., N. of a king of the Kin-naras.
—धरणी-
धर, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘bearing or sustaining the earth,’
epithet of the mythical elephants which are fabled
to support the earth; (अस्), m. epithet of Śeṣa; of
Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; of Śiva; a mountain; a tor-
toise; a king; N. of several persons; of a man of
the family of Maunin and son of Maheśvara; of the
father of Śaśi-dhara; of the father of Vāsu-deva and
grandfather of the author Hari-nātha; of the father
of Dayā-śaṅkara; of a scholiast on Manu; of a
Bodhi-sattva; (sometimes read धरणि-धर or
धरणीन्-धर.)
—धरणी-धृत्, त्, m. ‘sup-
porting the earth,’ an epithet of Śeṣa.
—धरणी-
पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the earth,’ a king.
—धरणी-
पूर, अस्, m. the ocean (as ‘surrounding the earth’).
—धरणी-प्लव, अस्, m. the ocean (‘in which
the earth floats’).
—धरणी-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, bearing or
supporting the earth; (त्), m. a mountain; a king;
(also read धरणि-भृत्.)
—धरणी-मण्डल,
अम्, n. ‘the sphere of the earth,’ the globe.
—ध-
रणी-रुह, अस्, m. ‘growing on the earth,’ a tree;
[cf. क्षिति-रुह् and क्षिति-रुह.]
—धरणीश्वर
(˚णि-ईश्˚), अस्, m. ‘lord of the earth,’ an epithet of
Śiva.
—धरणीश्वर-राज, अस्, m. ‘king of the
lords of the earth,’ N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—ध-
रणी-सुत, अस्, m. ‘son of the earth,’ an epithet of
Aṅgiras or the planet Mars; (आ), f. ‘the daughter
of the earth,’ an epithet of Sītā, wife of Rāma (as
produced from the soil by Janaka when he was
ploughing a spot to prepare it for a sacrifice).

धारण, अस्, ई, अम्, holding, bearing, carrying.
keeping, sustaining, preserving, maintaining, protect-
ing; possessing, having, assuming; keeping in re-
membrance; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Kaśyapa; of
a prince of the Candra-vatsas; (औ), m. du. the two
female breasts; (आ), f. the act of holding, supporting,
bearing, maintaining, preserving, keeping, holding
fast, keeping back; keeping in remembrance, retain-
[]
ing in the mind, a good memory; memory; keeping
the mind collected, holding the breath suspended
and all the natural wants restrained; steady or im-
movable abstraction of mind; fortitude, firmness,
steadiness, resolution; continuance in rectitude, keep-
ing in the right way; fixed precept or injunction, a
settled rule, certainty, conclusion; understanding, in-
tellect; conviction; (आस्), f. pl. the four days fol-
lowing the eighth day in the light half of month
Jyaiṣṭha; (ई), f. any tubular vessel of the body; a
mystical verse or charm or collection of such verses
among the Buddhists; a row or line, (wrong reading
for धोरणी); N. of a daughter of Svadhā [cf. धा-
रिणी]; (अम्), n. the act of holding, bearing, uphold-
ing, supporting, sustaining; possessing, possession;
containing; keeping, maintaining; observing, hold-
ing fast; keeping in the memory; immovable ab-
straction of the mind; restraining; (in grammar)
keeping back, i. e. pronouncing imperfectly; [cf.
अङ्क-ध्˚, असु-ध्˚, गर्भ-ध्˚, छत्त्र-ध्˚,
दण्ड-ध्˚, देह-ध्˚, &c.]
—धारण-पात्र,
अम्, n. a receptacle for the sieve (?) of a Buddhist
mendicant; a vessel for holding anything.
—धा-
रण-यन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of certain amulets.
—धा-
रणा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, depending on or connected
with abstraction of the mind.
—धारणा-योग, अस्,
m. deep devotion.
—धारणा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pos-
sessing memory, connected with memory.
—धा-
रणी-मति, इस्, m. (?), N. of a Samādhi.
—धारणी-
मुख-सर्व-जगत्-प्रणिधि-सन्धारण-गर्-
भ, अस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva.
—धारणी-
राज, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist work.
धरणि, इस्. See above under धरण.

धरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be held or kept, to be
borne or carried; supportable.
धरिणि, इस्, m. (?), N. of an Agastya.
धरित्री, f. a female bearer, supporter; the earth.

धरिमन्, आ, m. a balance, a pair of scales, a
weight; form, figure, semblance; [cf. धरीमन्.]
—धरिम-मेय, अस्, आ, अम्, measurable by weight.

धरीमन् = धर्मन् (only occurring in the
loc. धरीमणि), Ved. according to custom or law
or precept; (Sāy.) containing the essence of the
earth (as an altar); a vessel for holding anything.

1. धरुण, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see p. 451, col. 3), Ved.
carrying, holding, supporting, one who supports or
keeps; (अस्), m. the supposed author of a hymn of the
Ṛg-veda; an epithet of Brahmā; heaven, paradise;
water; opinion, conception; (अस्, ई, अम्), containing
in one's self, spacious; a place where anything is
preserved or kept; (अम्), n. a basis, foundation,
support, prop, stay; the firm soil of the earth; any-
thing that is undermost or innermost; a receptacle,
reservoir; water.
—धरुण-ह्वर, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. trembling in its innermost foundations ?; (Sāy.)
obstructing the flow of waters.

धरुण 2. धरुण, अस्, m. (fr. rt. धे?),
Ved. a sucking calf; (for 1. धरुण see p. 449,
col. 2; cf. धारु.)

धर्णस, अस्, आ, अम्, or धर्णसि or धर्णि,
इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. bearing, supporting, sustaining; a
supporter; strong, energetic, powerful, able; full of
spirit (as Soma); firm, durable; (धर्णसि in Naigh.
II. 9
. is one of the synonyms of बल, strength.)

धर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be upheld or supported;
to be held, had or possessed; to be placed or fixed.

धर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, holding, bearing, supporting;
(ता), m. a bearer, supporter, preserver.

धर्त्र, अम्, n. a prop, a stay; a house; a sacri-
fice; virtue, moral merit.

1. धर्म, अस्, अम्, m. n. (rarely n.; the older
form which occurs in the Ṛg-veda is धर्मन्, q. v.;
for 2. धर्म see p. 451, col. 3), that which is to be
held fast or kept, ordinance, statute, law, usage, practice,
custom, the customary observances of caste, sect, &c.;
religion, piety; prescribed course of conduct, duty,
(thus ‘giving alms’ &c. is the धर्म of the house-
holder, ‘administering justice’ of a king, ‘piety’ of a
Brāhman, ‘courage’ of a Kṣatriya); right, justice,
equity, anything right, proper, or just; virtue, mora-
lity, morals, merit, good works; nature, character,
the peculiar state or condition of anything; an
essential or characteristic quality, mark, peculiarity;
manner, resemblance; any sacrifice; a peculiar kind
of sacrifice; an Upaniṣad; religious abstraction,
devotion (= योग); associating with the virtuous;
a bow; a drinker of Soma juice; Right, Justice,
Law, or Virtue personified (as born from the right
breast of Brahmā, and having Śama, Kāma, and
Harṣa as his offspring); or personified as a Bull;
or personified as a Dove; a N. of Yama (the Hindū
Pluto, ruler of the lower regions, god of justice, and
judge of the dead); one of the attendants of the god
of the Sun; Justice or Virtue identified with Viṣṇu;
also identified with Prajā-pati, and said to be son-in-
law of Dakṣa; N. of the fifteenth Arhat of the
present Ava-sarpiṇī, descended from Ikṣvāku, son of
Bhānu and Su-vratā; N. of a son of Anu and father
of Ghṛta; of a son of Gāndhāra and father of
Dhṛta; of a son of Haihaya and father of Netra;
of a son of Pṛthu-śravas and father of Uśanas; of a
son of Su-vrata; of a son of Dīrgha-tapas; of a
prince of Kaśmīra; of a lexicographer; (in astrology)
N. of the ninth mansion; धर्मात् or धर्मेण,
ind. according to right, rightly, justly, according to
rule, according to the nature of anything.
—धर्-
म-कथक, अस्, m. a propounder of the law.
—धर्म-कथा, f. a discourse upon law, &c.
—धर्म-कर्मन्, अ, n. a work of duty or piety;
any virtuous or pious action.
—धर्म-काम, अस्,
आ, अम्, loving justice, observing right or duty; (अस्),
m., N. of a son of the demon Pāpīyas; of a god of
the Bodhi tree.
—धर्म-कामार्थ-सम्बद्ध
(˚म-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, joined with or containing
virtue, pleasure, and wealth.
—धर्म-काय, अस्, m.
‘the body of law or of abstract existence,’ epithet of one
of the three bodies of a Buddha; (अस्), m. a Buddha;
a Jina or Jaina saint; an epithet of Avalokiteśvara.
—धर्म-कार, अस्, m. a doer or observer of the
law; N. of a person.
—धर्म-कारण, अम्, n.
cause of virtue.
—धर्म-कार्य, अम्, n. any act of
duty or religion (as digging a well, building a temple,
&c.); pious act, good work, virtuous conduct.
—धर्-
म-कीर्त्ति, इस्, m. ‘glory of religion,’ N. of a poet; of
a logician; of a king mentioned in the twenty-first
chapter of the Vṛhan-nāradīya-Purāṇa.
—धर्म-
कील, अस्, m. royal edict or order, decree, grant.
—धर्म-कीलक, अस्, m. the command of a
Brāhman.
—धर्म-कूप, अस्, m. ‘the holy well,’
N. of a Tīrtha.
—१. धर्म-कृत्, त्, त्, त् (for 2.
see under धर्मन्), fulfilling duty, one who acts
justly or practises virtue.
—धर्म-कृत्य, अम्, n.
fulfilment of duty, virtue; any moral or religious
observance.
—धर्म-केतु, उस्, m. ‘having justice
for a banner or symbol,’ N. of a son of Su-ketu and
father of Satya-ketu; N. of a Buddha; of a Jaina
deified saint.
—धर्म-कोश or धर्म-कोष, अस्,
m. the treasury of law or duties; the collective body
of laws or duties.
—धर्मकोश-व्याख्या, f. ‘the
explanation of the treasury of law,’ N. of a Buddhist
work.
—धर्म-क्रिया, f. observance of duties,
acting according to law, righteous conduct, any reli-
gious act or pious work.
—धर्म-क्षेत्र, अम्, n.
the department or province of the law; a plain in
the north-west of India near Delhi (the scene of the
[]
great battle between the Kurus and Pāṇḍus, com-
monly called Kuru-kṣetra); (अस्), m. a man of piety
and virtue.
—धर्म-गञ्ज, अस्, m. ‘treasury of
law or religion,’ N. of a library.
—धर्म-गवेष,
अस्, m. ‘seeking virtue &c.,’ N. of a man.
